name: union_pnl_cash_outcomes
indexes: CREATE INDEX union_pnl_cash_outcomes_expr_recognized_at_idx ON public.union_pnl_cash_outcomes USING btree (((game_scope ->> 'game_union_id'::text)), recognized_at)
CREATE INDEX union_pnl_cash_outcomes_recognition_join_cover ON public.union_pnl_cash_outcomes USING btree (recognized_at) INCLUDE (table_id, hand_number)
CREATE INDEX union_pnl_cash_outcomes_recognition_window ON public.union_pnl_cash_outcomes USING btree (recognized_at)

CREATE INDEX union_pnl_cash_outcomes_scope_missing ON public.union_pnl_cash_outcomes USING btree (recognized_at) WHERE (NOT (game_scope ?& ARRAY['game_union_id'::text, 'host_club_id'::text, 'tournament_id'::text, 'is_private'::text, 'asset'::text, 'unit_scale'::text]))

CREATE INDEX union_pnl_cash_outcomes_unaccepted ON public.union_pnl_cash_outcomes USING btree (((game_scope ->> 'game_union_id'::text)), recognized_at) WHERE (((evidence ->> 'status'::text) IS DISTINCT FROM 'ready'::text) OR ((evidence -> 'basis_certified'::text) IS DISTINCT FROM 'true'::jsonb) OR ((evidence -> 'all_players_included'::text) IS DISTINCT FROM 'true'::jsonb) OR ((evidence -> 'game_scope'::text) IS DISTINCT FROM game_scope))
CREATE UNIQUE INDEX union_pnl_cash_outcomes_hand_id_key ON public.union_pnl_cash_outcomes USING btree (hand_id)
CREATE UNIQUE INDEX union_pnl_cash_outcomes_pkey ON public.union_pnl_cash_outcomes USING btree (table_id, hand_number)

name: union_pnl_cash_outcome_link_resolutions

constraints.name: union_pnl_cash_outcome_link_resolutions_check2
constraints.definition: CHECK ((((proof ->> 'status'::text) = 'proven'::text) AND ((proof ->> 'resolution_kind'::text) = 'cash_outcome_provenance_link'::text) AND ((proof ->> 'table_id'::text) = (table_id)::text) AND (((proof ->> 'hand_number'::text))::bigint = hand_number) AND ((proof ->> 'hand_id'::text) = (hand_id)::text) AND ((proof ->> 'outcome_payload_hash'::text) = outcome_payload_hash) AND ((proof ->> 'outcome_evidence_md5'::text) = outcome_evidence_md5) AND ((proof ->> 'roster_source'::text) = roster_source) AND (NOT ((proof ->> 'manifest_id'::text) IS DISTINCT FROM (manifest_id)::text)) AND ((proof -> 'game_scope'::text) = game_scope) AND ((proof -> 'evidence'::text) = evidence) AND ((evidence -> 'game_scope'::text) = game_scope)))

indexes: CREATE INDEX union_pnl_cash_links_valid_proof_hand ON public.union_pnl_cash_outcome_link_resolutions USING btree (hand_id) INCLUDE (table_id, hand_number) WHERE (proof_md5 = md5((proof)::text))
CREATE UNIQUE INDEX union_pnl_cash_outcome_link_resolutions_hand_id_key ON public.union_pnl_cash_outcome_link_resolutions USING btree (hand_id)
CREATE UNIQUE INDEX union_pnl_cash_outcome_link_resolutions_pkey ON public.union_pnl_cash_outcome_link_resolutions USING btree (table_id, hand_number)
